column2: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 05.12.2019
It  is an  offense  to  maintain  premises  without a  license or  violate  any  provision  under  this  By-law  and  after
being convicted by a court of competent jurisdiction for such offense is liable to a fine referred to in section
122 (2) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act No.15 of 1987 must be. Upon receipt of a written notice by the Chairman
or the Medical Officer of Health or the Public Health Inspector, the violator or the violator shall continue to
observe such violation when a person has been fined after being convicted of an offense. Every single day the
violation continues the components must be subject to an additional fine above section.
